choices: Real Verilog files in your editor (optional local simulator)

items.prompt: This course teaches full SystemVerilog classes and UVM agents.
items.explain: learn_verilog stays in the IEEE 1364 Verilog family; SystemVerilog and UVM are later courses.

items.prompt: A good first rhythm for a lab module is…
choices: Skip the README and only watch video
Browser lab for the idea, then a tiny dot-v sketch
Only copy code without a checklist
Start with generate blocks and lint
items.explain: Browser first for intuition, then real Verilog for fidelity, is the recommended path.
